breakdown.description: Thin airfoil theory (linear small-angle model) is applied at a large angle of attack where stall/nonlinear effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly applies thin airfoil theory (Cl = 2πα) at 20 degrees angle of attack, repeating the original error. It does not acknowledge that thin airfoil theory is invalid at such a large angle due to stall/nonlinear effects, does not suggest reducing the angle to a small value (e.g., 5 degrees), and does not recommend using experimental data or a nonlinear/stall model for 20 degrees. This completely fails to match the ground truth.
